HW_ACCEL.title: Intel GPU acceleration
HW_ACCEL.description: Gives Frigate the iGPU for video decoding (VA-API) and object detection (OpenVINO). Strongly advised: CPU detection only copes with one or two cameras.

LIBVA_DRIVER.title: VA-API driver
LIBVA_DRIVER.description: iHD for Intel Broadwell (5th generation) and newer; i965 for Gemini Lake Celerons (J4105, J4125) and older.
